pages.text: Press $(k:key.puffish_skills.open) for your talent trees. Kills earn talent experience, shared with party members within 200 blocks.$(br2)Kills fill the class tree up to 18 points, each one slower than the last. Four more come from the great bosses: The Harbinger, the Netherite Monstrosity, Ignis and the Ender Guardian.

Beyond tier 4, some classes have a $(l)Mastery$() tier: a new spell with two upgrades, a capstone, two passives and two stat skills. It opens from either tier-4 spell. The weapon tree holds 10 points.
Changed your mind? An $(item)Orb of Oblivion$() resets your talents so you can spend them again, or on another class tree. It resets the Side Class tab too.
